subject: science
concept: Understanding that gravity pulls objects toward the Earth
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Physical Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Forces and Motion) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student drops various real or virtual objects and observes them fall toward the ground
exercise.pictorial: Student predicts which direction a released object will fall in a pictured scenario
exercise.abstract: Student explains, in their own words, why dropped objects fall down rather than in another direction

misconception_flags: believes heavier objects always fall faster than lighter ones in the same conditions

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
